recipes.title: Hand-painted character film
recipes.summary: A short 2D mascot story with painted shapes, controlled line boil and a frame-review workflow.

duration.description: Sequence duration in seconds; retain interaction timings for UI.

recipes.prompt: Build a short hand-painted 2D character film using the pinned ClaudeAnimationBase starter as a separately installed reference. Use a mascot supplied by the user or a new original design; replace the bundled Clawd art and demo story. Start with STORYBOARD.md: a goal, an obstacle, a payoff, a small palette, timed actions and reactions, and transitions connecting the scenes. Wait for storyboard feedback before scene implementation. Add a new scene file and point studio.html to it. Make each frame deterministic from time, seed stable objects independently, and use anticipation, arcs, overlapping motion and holds so actions read clearly. Use local fonts and separately licensed assets. Review the renderer and dependency licenses before running it. Prefer a sandboxed Chrome process; run the upstream Linux no-sandbox route only in a disposable non-root environment without secrets or untrusted input. Render contact sheets, motion strips and contact-detail crops; inspect them before the final local MP4. Preserve John Heibel’s MIT notice and distinguish this adaptation from the full original guide.
